title: Perplexity’s free AI offer left it with millions more users in India | TechCrunch
summary: In July 2025, Perplexity partnered with Airtel, India’s second biggest telecom operator, to offer a free 12-month Perplexity Pro subscription, normally worth about $200, to the Indian carrier’s 360 million customers.
